candidates.summary: the diff installs the registry's name rule in the handler and leaves gnoweb's only producer of /u/ links on a wider, incompatible pattern
candidates.failure_scenario: mentionNamePattern is `^@([A-Za-z0-9_]{3,90})(?:[^A-Za-z0-9_-]|$)` and is the only code in the tree that emits /u/<name> hrefs (ext_mentions.go:84 and :114). The gate the diff adds at handler_http.go:610 accepts gno.Re_name plus a 64 cap, i.e. `^[a-z][a-z0-9]*([_-][a-z0-9]+)*$`. They disagree in both directions and neither was swept. Wider: a realm rendering `@user_with_many_________underscores_and_numbers_12345` still gets `<a href="/u/user_with_many_________underscores_and_numbers_12345">` -- that exact href is already a golden fixture in this package, markdown/golden/ext_mentions/user_mentions.md.txtar:13 -- and that page now returns 404 with no chain query, where before the diff it returned 200. Narrower: mentionNamePattern excludes `-`, so a registered user named `foo-bar`, which Re_name and r/sys/users both accept, gets no mention link at all; `@foo-bar` renders `@foo` linked to /u/foo plus the literal text `-bar`. The address half is a third shape again: mentionAddressPattern at :29 is `g1[0-9A-Za-z]{37,90}`, uppercase-tolerant and 39-92 chars, while the page gate now uses crypto.AddressFromBech32, which is exactly 40 lowercase chars with a checksum.
candidates.verify_by: grep -n 'mentionNamePattern\|mentionAddressPattern' gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/markdown/ext_mentions.go; grep -n 'user_with_many' gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/markdown/golden/ext_mentions/user_mentions.md.txtar; grep -n 'ErrInvalidUsername' examples/gno.land/r/sys/users/errors.gno; then add `/u/user_with_many_________underscores_and_numbers_12345` to the reject table at handler_http_test.go:2120 and run `go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb -run TestHTTPHandler_GetUserView_RejectsInvalidNames`: it passes, which is the 404 on gnoweb's own rendered link
candidates.evidence: ext_mentions.go:28 `mentionNamePattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^@([A-Za-z0-9_]{3,90})(?:[^A-Za-z0-9_-]|$)`)`; ext_mentions.go:84 `link.Destination = append([]byte("/u/"), line[start:end]...)`; golden/ext_mentions/user_mentions.md.txtar:13 `<a href="/u/user_with_many_________underscores_and_numbers_12345">`; examples/gno.land/r/sys/users/errors.gno:19 `username must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9]*([_-][a-z0-9]+)*$ (max 64 chars)`; gnovm/pkg/gnolang/mempackage.go:70 Re_name `separators (`_` or `-`) only between alphanumerics, never consecutive, never trailing`

candidates.summary: CreateUsernameFromBech32 was rewritten to validate the address before shortening it; the sibling shortener truncMiddle validates nothing and abbreviates to a different width
candidates.failure_scenario: The class the diff rewrote is `abbreviate a bech32 address for display`. Its other member is the template func truncMiddle (template.go:56), used at components/views/overview.html:45 as `{{ truncMiddle . 6 }}` over .Info.Creator. It keeps 6+6 runes joined by a Unicode ellipsis, while the rewritten CreateUsernameFromBech32 keeps 4+4 joined by three ASCII dots, so one address renders as `g1edq4…gleuc8p` on a package overview and `g1ed...uc8p` on that same account's user page. truncMiddle also applies no bech32 check at all -- the loose validation the diff just replaced in the handler -- so any Creator string the node returns is silently chopped, including one that is not an address.
candidates.verify_by: sed -n '56,62p' gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/components/template.go and sed -n '45p' .../components/views/overview.html, beside CreateUsernameFromBech32 at handler_http.go:580: two widths, two separators, one validated and one not
candidates.evidence: template.go:56-61 `return string(r[:keep]) + "…" + string(r[len(r)-keep:])`; overview.html:45 `{{ truncMiddle . 6 }}`; handler_http.go:583 `return username[:4] + "..." + username[len(username)-4:]`

candidates.summary: the shape gate runs before buildContributions, so the `namespace with packages` arm the PR promises is unreachable for any namespace the user-name rule rejects
candidates.failure_scenario: The rewrite replaced `serve every /u/<name>` with three arms: address, namespace with packages, registered user. The shape check is applied first and returns 404 before ListPaths is ever called, so the second arm is really `shape AND packages`. maxUsernameLen = 64 is the r/sys/users cap (store.gno:30), not a VM rule: Re_gnoUserPkgPath (mempackage.go:49-54) bounds the USER component by Re_name with no length limit, so a namespace of 65+ lowercase characters can legally hold packages. On any chain where r/sys/names is not enabled -- gnodev, a local test node, a chain before names were turned on -- such a namespace is deployable, and /u/<it> now 404s with packages sitting under it, where the old code rendered them.
candidates.verify_by: on the head worktree, gnodev or a local node with names disabled: addpkg gno.land/r/<65 lowercase chars>/home, then GET /u/<that name>; observe 404 with no vm/qpaths query in the node log. Static half: grep -n 'maxUsernameLen' handler_http.go against grep -n 'maxNameLen' examples/gno.land/r/sys/users/store.gno and the absence of any length bound in Re_gnoUserPkgPath, gnovm/pkg/gnolang/mempackage.go:49-54
candidates.evidence: handler_http.go:608-611 gate returns 404 before the buildContributions call at :613; store.gno:30 `const maxNameLen = 64` is the registry's own cap; mempackage.go:53 `r.N("USER", Re_name)` carries no length bound
